duration.text: The Electrical Engineering & Automation at Shanghai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport copy2.ID photo3.Selfie video4.Highest Degree Certificate and Official Transcripts5.Certificate of No Criminal Record6.Language Proficiency Certificate7.Study Plan or Research Proposal in China8.Statement of Financial Support9.Guarantee Statement （under 18 years old）10.Others（Refer to Departmental standards）

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizen in good health with a valid passport;2.Applicants studying for a bachelor’s degree should have obtained high school diploma;3.High school graduate, GPA 3.0 or above（Note: 4-Point GPA System）4.IELTS (A) 6.5 or TOEFL IBT 90 or above received within the recent two years（TOEFL MyBestTM Scores accepted & TOEFL essentials）.Other internationally recognized English proficiency tests with scores of the same level and provide proof of certificates.
